title: Implement typed ShoppingListDocument mutations
description: Implement the typed mutation APIs on `ShoppingListDocument` for item insertion, update, toggle, removal, meal insertion, and aisle deletion with the locked-in aisle lifecycle behavior.
acceptance_criteria: `addItem`, `updateItem`, `toggle`, `removeItem`, `deleteAisle`, and `addMealsEntry` are implemented against structured fields rather than text editing.
Aisle lookup for `addItem` is case-insensitive and appends a new aisle when no match exists.
Removing the last item auto-prunes the aisle in line with the locked decision, and `addMealsEntry` is idempotent on exact string equality.

handoff_summary.completed: All six mutation methods are implemented against structured fields. `addItem` uses case-insensitive aisle lookup and appends a new aisle when no match exists. `removeItem` now auto-prunes the aisle when its last item is removed. `addMealsEntry` is idempotent on exact string equality.
handoff_summary.remaining: No remaining work in this bead. Test coverage for the mutation APIs (including the auto-prune behavior) belongs to the tester bead.
handoff_summary.risks: The auto-prune behavior in `removeItem` is a behavior change from the prior stub (which kept empty aisles). Any view-layer code that expected an empty aisle to persist after all items are removed will need updating in its own bead.
handoff_summary.next_action: Scheduler should schedule the tester bead for mutation coverage.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: View-layer beads that call `removeItem` and then inspect the aisle list should account for auto-pruning — an aisle may no longer exist after the last item is removed.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Auto-prune on `removeItem` matches the locked Key Design Decision in spec-855cd963. The aisle is removed in the same mutation call rather than lazily on render.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: The auto-prune path (remove last item → aisle disappears) and the non-prune path (remove non-last item → aisle persists) both need unit test coverage in the tester bead.

conflict_risks: View-layer beads that call `removeItem` and then inspect the aisle list should account for auto-pruning — an aisle may no longer exist after the last item is removed.

execution_history.summary: Implemented auto-prune behavior in `removeItem`: after removing an item, the aisle is also removed if it becomes empty. All other mutations (`addItem`, `updateItem`, `toggle`, `deleteAisle`, `addMealsEntry`) were already correctly implemented in prior beads. Build passes cleanly.
